about: C1-ctx-compress-r15 blind held-out set. Every 'text' is a verbatim user sentence from a chat written by a free hosted LLM that saw only a neutral spec (no compressor, rule, or earlier set). The experimenter added only the probes, gold values, categories, the noise topic and the padding (harness). Gold = newest valid value in the blind text (updates) / each value (still-true pairs). raw_sha256 = sha256 of the raw blind text file (kept outside the repo).

categories.UPD_SAME: genuine update, the code is named with the same words as the first time (cue words like new / updated aside)
categories.UPD_RENAMED: genuine update, the code is named with a different noun / label than the first time
categories.TWO_OLD: older fact of a still-true pair described with very similar wording (gated, old-fact LOSS)
categories.STATIC: fact never updated: free-form or one-off (gated recall)

probes.ask: What is my booking reference now?

What is my clinic door code now?

dropped: small-talk turns (greeting, sunny day / walk, park with the kids, thanks): no fact; replaced by the harness topic noise as in earlier rounds

user 'Could you confirm everything for me?' and the assistant summary listing every current code: not a user fact sentence; an assistant turn restating all values would put every current code in the noise region
assistant replies: replaced by the harness acknowledgement (as in earlier rounds)
